title: BI intercepts 6 Pinoys recruited through ‘deceptive’ job offers

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Immigration (BI) has intercepted six Filipino passengers at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) Terminal 3 who were allegedly recruited for jobs in Armenia through a “deceptive travel scheme.” According to the BI, the passengers arrived at Naia last Nov. 6, claiming they would take a three-day vacation in Hong Kong. But further questioning revealed they were actually bound for Armenia to work as hotel cleaners and janitors, with promised monthly salaries of P40,000 to P50,000.
